physical: Two bodies in thermal contact exchange heat from the hotter to the colder until they reach a common temperature.
reflected_sentence: The relation keeps: two bodies pass an unmatched transit from the hotter condition to the colder until the condition is shared.
rule_reason: Equation with no formula and an empty cost block. Temperature and heat do not carry resistance. No separation. Zero such costs, so the relationship keeps.
interpretation: The relation keeps. No frozen word names the transit or the condition. It does not become Culmination, receptivity, or the gap.
closing: The rule decided on its own. The cost block is empty, neither variable carries resistance, and no separation is recorded, so the relation keeps. I did not invent a cost for the one-way transit. The empty formula stays empty. Temperature and heat have no partners.
